snippet.title: Magnavox Odyssey Table Tennis 1972
snippet.description:
In 1972 Magnavox introduced ODYSSEY 
The world's first ever commercial home video game console.

It featured no color graphics. No 3D graphics. No sound. 
And no digital processor.
All analog engineering.


The following is an actual screen recording of the game "Table Tennis".
Again, no sound. No color. Just simple game play.

This is how the video gaming revolution began over 40 years ago.
